original_obligation.quoted_target: Arbitrary-shear inverse with a bounded analytic remainder: recover the actual nonlinear optical map and beta domain, prove an explicit-radius and explicit-constant norm bound, and distinguish arbitrary shear from the small-shear truncation branch.
explicit_assumptions: For this successor, D is fixed, real, symmetric, and 3x3.
The exact map and positive square-root branch are imported from the reviewed ExactBoostMap dependency.
Pointwise estimates assume q(beta)<1; ball estimates assume 0<=r<1 and eNorm(beta)<=r.
No invertibility of D and no H(D) != 0 assumption is used in this successor.

scope.conclusion: A genuine source-linked Euclidean analytic remainder estimate, cubic pointwise and on every explicit subluminal ball, plus its quadratic corollary and r=1/2 specialization.

theorem_signature:
theorem remainder_factorization (D : M3) (hD : forall i j, D i j = D j i) (beta : V3) (hbeta : q beta < 1) : remainder D beta = (-2 * boostA beta) • (q beta • D.mulVec beta + (gamma beta * sourceQuadratic D beta) • beta)

theorem remainder_norm_le_pointwise (D : M3) (hD : forall i j, D i j = D j i) (beta : V3) (hbeta : q beta < 1) : eNorm (remainder D beta) <= (2 * opNorm D / (1 - q beta)) * eNorm beta ^ 3

theorem remainder_norm_le_cubic_ball (D : M3) (hD : forall i j, D i j = D j i) (beta : V3) (r : Real) (hr0 : 0 <= r) (hr1 : r < 1) (hbeta : eNorm beta <= r) : eNorm (remainder D beta) <= (2 * opNorm D / (1 - r ^ 2)) * eNorm beta ^ 3

theorem remainder_norm_le_quadratic_ball (D : M3) (hD : forall i j, D i j = D j i) (beta : V3) (r : Real) (hr0 : 0 <= r) (hr1 : r < 1) (hbeta : eNorm beta <= r) : eNorm (remainder D beta) <= (2 * r * opNorm D / (1 - r ^ 2)) * eNorm beta ^ 2

theorem remainder_norm_le_half (D : M3) (hD : forall i j, D i j = D j i) (beta : V3) (hbeta : eNorm beta <= (1 / 2 : Real)) : eNorm (remainder D beta) <= (8 / 3 : Real) * opNorm D * eNorm beta ^ 3 and eNorm (remainder D beta) <= (4 / 3 : Real) * opNorm D * eNorm beta ^ 2
accepted_lemma_signatures: eNorm_sq (v : V3) : eNorm v ^ 2 = q v
matrixOp_apply (D : M3) (v : V3) : matrixOp D (toE v) = toE (D.mulVec v)
abs_dot3_le (v w : V3) : |dot3 v w| <= eNorm v * eNorm w
eNorm_mulVec_le (D : M3) (v : V3) : eNorm (D.mulVec v) <= opNorm D * eNorm v
eNorm_add_le (v w : V3) : eNorm (v + w) <= eNorm v + eNorm w
eNorm_smul (c : Real) (v : V3) : eNorm (c • v) = |c| * eNorm v
gamma_ge_one (beta : V3) (hbeta : q beta < 1) : 1 <= gamma beta
boostA_nonneg (beta : V3) (hbeta : q beta < 1) : 0 <= boostA beta
gamma_sq_sub_one (beta : V3) (hbeta : q beta < 1) : gamma beta ^ 2 - 1 = q beta / (1 - q beta)
ball_denominator (beta : V3) (r : Real) (hr0 : 0 <= r) (hr1 : r < 1) (hbeta : eNorm beta <= r) : 0 < 1 - r ^ 2 and 1 - r ^ 2 <= 1 - q beta
